newsitem.title: CANADA: Ontario to merge 3 financial regulators into one.
newsitem.headline: Ontario to merge 3 financial regulators into one.

text.p: The Province of Ontario said on Tuesday that it had introduced legislation to create the Financial Services Commission of Ontario by merging three insurance and pension regulators.

Ontario Finance Minister Ernie Eves said in a statement that the commission created by the merger of the Ontario Insurance Commission, the Pension Commission of Ontario and the Deposit Institutions Division of the Finance Ministry would regulate pensions, insurance, trust companies, credit unions, caisses populaires, co-operatives and mortgage brokers.
Eves said the move is expected to save the government C$3.8 million.

"It is another step toward better regulation of Ontario's financial services and better protection of consumers," Eves said in the release. "It will help create a more efficient financial services sector which contributes to Ontario's economic growth."
